intro.text: Welcome to the Sink or Float Lab! Let's find out what the water does.

mode-predict.text: Predict and test! Make a guess, then drop it in.

mode-tricky.text: Tricky ones! Big and small can surprise you.

mode-pond.text: Water playground! Drop in anything you like.

tricky-intro.text: These ones are tricky! Big things can float, and tiny things can sink.

pond-intro.text: This is your water playground. Drop things in, and watch what happens!

predict-prompt.text: What do you think? Will it sink, or will it float?

result-float.text: It floats! It stays on top of the water.

result-sink.text: It sinks! Down, down, to the bottom.

praise-1.text: You predicted it! Great scientist thinking.

surprise-1.text: Ooh, a surprise! Scientists love surprises.

surprise-2.text: Interesting! Now we know something new.

nudge-predict.text: Pick a guess. Sink, or float?

nudge-drop.text: Drag it over the water and let go!

end-cheer.text: Your journal page is full! What wonderful watching.
